value.title: Destiny
value.synopsis: Leaving Masamune's world behind, they next head to another world where the Master Orb has been stolen. It is a battlefield where the revolutionary army, led by the military genius Kirinji, is fighting against a strange army led by a Core-wielding being. They propose joining forces with Kirinji, and the group joins forces with the revolutionary army. Meanwhile, Yakumo notices a secret problem that Rinne is harboring...

value.title: The End and the Beginning
value.synopsis: In Neo's world, where the Master Orb was once stolen, the reaction of the World User appears once again. Its true identity is a structure floating in space - a gigantic Core Holder that is falling towards the Earth! To prevent a collision with the Earth, Neo and his friends take off into space in a shuttle. They launch a desperate plan to infiltrate the Core Holder and destroy it!

value.title: Jugemu
value.synopsis: The barrier of the White Library has been broken by a masked man - a World User. A large army of Core holders invades the interior. The World User's goal is the Primordial Orb, said to be stored in the deepest part of the White Library. In Jugemu's absence, standing in the World User's way is Strike Island's guardian deity, God Strike.

value.title: Friends
value.synopsis: The Primordial Orb has fallen into the hands of Angry, the World User. Strike Island is shrouded in ominous dark clouds. However, with his newfound powers, Jugemu defeats the Thunder Monster Kakagosedek and corners Angry. Angry seizes a momentary gap to escape, and absorbs the power of the Caliente Volcano into himself in order to eliminate the Irregulars...!

value.title: Linne
value.synopsis: Angry, who had transformed into a fiery monster, was defeated by Jugemu. However, a boy who uses worlds suddenly appeared and cut Jugemu in half, sending fresh blood flying into the air. Witnessing Jugemu's body cut in half, Rinne awakens. A large bullet of light is fired from Rinne's spirit gun and approaches the boy who uses worlds...!

value.title: A Place To Belong
value.synopsis: After retrieving the Master Orb from the world user Nowhere, Linne awakens to her true power. However, Nowhere also transforms into an eerie monster. Claiming not to see what she doesn't need to see, Nowhere attacks with overwhelming force. However, Linne retains the power of the bonds they have built up until now... The final battle between Linne and Nowhere begins.
